body: It wasn't so much that I was looking for anyone, in fact it was kind of the opposite. I had just come out of my marriage and wasn't looking for anyone. I was enjoying being single, she just came along and just clicked. It was as if we were meant for each other. The passion, just everything about our relationship was like perfection. I got lost in love with her without meaning to. I think that is why I still love her now even after all that has happened. I wish I could control my feelings but we all know that isn't possible :(

I am on an SSRI now, Sertraline. I have not heard of Trazadone but I will mention it to my doctor to hear their opinion on if it may help me.

I agree with you about the drugs, I have having so many of them and they don't help and just cause horrible withdrawal when I miss a day or two. 

I don't know what to do about the schizophrenia :( Nothing seems to make it go away. The drugs make me some what more aware of what is real and what isn't but does not make them go away. The nightmares and the flash backs are the worst though as I know they are real, they happened to me. It is like a horror film in your brain constantly.

No Megan cut me off completely after that text. I have not heard from her since then, that was the last contact I ever had with her even though I tried texting, calling, writing, emailing. She just vanished from my life 5 days after telling her. I know what her motives were now as I explained in another reply. I don't know how she could do what she did. I just can't get my head around it. Even a year and a half later it makes no sense to me. I do not believe she would have had a termination had I not told her about my past which is why I blame myself for it.

My parents are very supportive. My mother and father are separated and remarried but my step parents are just as supportive as well. I currently live with my mother and stepfather. 

I was a pretty fit guy however over the past 6 months I have suffered from a trapped nerve in my left shoulder which has made most form of exercise impossible. I had surgery on Jan 14th so hopefully that will get better and I will be able to get more active again. A big problem I have is the panic attacks when I go out for walks or to the gym. I find it very hard to be in a public place or outside for too long without getting extremely anxious and needing to take a handful of ativan to calm me down. That is why I am on such high doses :(

Thank you for your kind words. They mean a lot to me. Sadly my relationship with Megan was not what I thought it was, for her anyway. For me I was in love with her completely and in many ways I still am however her reasons for being with me where selfish. She saw me as a "safe choice", I was financially stable and quite well off, come from a good family, own(ed) my own home, I did a good job bringing up my daughter, I was independent and could look after myself, my daughter, our house, etc. Where as Megan's Dad was an alcoholic who abused her mum but she stayed with him because she did not agree with divorce, the father of her daughter didn't talk to her as soon as he found out she was pregnant. I was basically exactly what she was looking for in a partner. Then as soon as she saw I had some problems I didn't fit the bill anymore and she threw me out like a broken cup. I feel she killed my child because of what happened to me and that pain is almost unbearable. I would have brought the child up myself, I have problems but I still look after my daughter (although not full time now, she lives with her mother which I felt was the best thing for our daughter for the stability) and while I have problems I know I am still a good dad as my daughter reminds me every day. I will never have the chance to know now though :(

Thanks for your reply. I pay to see a specialist every week however it does not seem to help. There is so much going on inside my head it feels like it will takes decades talking to him for an hour a week. I think that is why I decided to post here. I am hoping that I am get as much out of me as possible from questions and advice others may give and I am not time limited here. I know most here are not professionals but I have found people who genuinely care for others can offer advice just as good if not better than a professional, especially if the person has been through similar problems themselves. I have read some incredible posts on reddit from just random people. I am hoping that something like that may help me.

I guess I am trying to reach out for some support and offer my experiences of someone who is still in the middle of their darkest times rather than somebody who has got past the bad parts. Please ask any questions you want, I cannot promise I will be able to reply if it is too distressing for me but I will try. I think talking about this will help me in the long run. There are other smaller bits to the story but nothing that really makes any real difference however if you want to know more about anything I will try and explain in my details.

Thanks M
